attempts.sql: SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%' GROUP BY split_part(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query identifies immediate subfolders beneath auto_ontology/server/ by filtering file paths that have at least one additional directory level beyond server/. It sums the line_count for all Python files in each subfolder (including test files and __init__.py), then returns only those subfolders where the cumulative line total exceeds 1,000. The folder_path column shows the repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and total_lines shows the aggregated line count.
sql: SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%' GROUP BY split_part(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000
